preconditions.description: The number of planets n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of plans q must be between 1 and 100,000.
The index of earth s must be a valid planet index between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers, one for each planet.
Each output integer must be either a non-negative cost or -1 indicating impossibility.
The cost to reach the earth planet (index s) must be 0.
